claim: Media Studio CI now has real Flatpak-builder/runtime smoke coverage and a manual VAAPI/NVENC self-hosted GPU matrix with fail-closed hardware conversion proof.

output.claim_status: PARTIAL: the intended workflow shapes are present, but the exact claim is not acceptance-complete.
output.summary: The files show a real Flatpak-builder/install/run path, a manual self-hosted matrix, exact encoder availability checks, and an application fallback-disabled path. Stale Flatpak input, missing timeout, false verification semantics, incomplete encoder proof, incomplete runner requirements, and sandbox/trust defects block the exact claim.
material_defects: HIGH — current-source contract — .github/workflows/ci.yml:92-109 and packaging/flatpak/io.github.stranmor.MediaStudio.yml:29-32: Flatpak-builder uses the fixed commit 63dc708153b76ab7f7527579f103ce24ac106872, not the checked-out revision, with no equality to github.sha. Current Rust, manifest, or wrapper changes can therefore be ignored. Correction: use a CI-only checkout-directory source or bind and assert the event SHA.

HIGH — bounded-job contract — .github/workflows/ci.yml:80-109: the Flatpak job has no explicit timeout-minutes and its builder/install/run operations have no command timeout. A network, runtime, or application hang is not bounded by the repository contract. Correction: add an explicit job timeout and bounded smoke commands.

HIGH — verification contract — src/engine.rs: the RESULT=verified log line is written even when config.verify_results is false; packaging/gpu/hardware-smoke.sh:49-60 only checks file size, ffprobe duration, and that marker. This does not fail closed on disabled or incomplete verification. Correction: emit RESULT=verified only after verification, fail when verification is disabled, and add independent full decode plus an exact-line marker check.

HIGH — exact-encoder-use contract — packaging/gpu/hardware-smoke.sh:24-25,42-60 checks that FFmpeg advertises h264_vaapi or h264_nvenc, but does not assert that the selected profile command actually uses that encoder or the VAAPI device. HARDWARE=... is logged during capability selection, before invocation. Correction: validate backend-to-profile encoder mapping in Rust, log the exact selected encoder/device, and assert the command/output contract in the script.

MEDIUM — runner contract — .github/workflows/gpu.yml:21-27 and docs/ci/gpu-runners.md: the application requires systemd-run via engine::ensure_tools, but the workflow preflight and runner document do not require it. NVENC requirements also omit exact NVIDIA device nodes, permissions, driver/toolchain expectations, and Rust requirements. Correction: add preflight checks and explicit per-runner provisioning requirements.

HIGH — sandbox safety contract — packaging/flatpak/io.github.stranmor.MediaStudio.yml:9-20 grants filesystem=host and broad host/system D-Bus access. The installed app is not least-privilege or production-sandbox-ready, and the version/profile smoke does not justify those permissions. Correction: narrow permissions in the production manifest, or isolate host integration in an explicitly non-production manifest.

HIGH — CI trust contract — .github/workflows/ci.yml:82-84 runs pull-request-controlled Flatpak build commands in a privileged container with network access. Correction: remove unnecessary privilege, isolate the build, restrict token permissions, and avoid exposing sensitive credentials.

MEDIUM — self-hosted trust/supply-chain contract — .github/workflows/gpu.yml:3-4,20 and action references throughout the workflows allow manual dispatch from the selected ref and use mutable @main/@master action refs. Manual-only is event isolation, not a protected-ref guarantee. Correction: pin action SHAs, set contents:read, and gate GPU execution to a protected ref/environment.
MEDIUM — reproducibility contract — packaging/flatpak/io.github.stranmor.MediaStudio.yml:2-3 uses the mutable runtime-version master. Correction: pin a supported stable runtime branch/ref.
evidence_gaps: No external GitHub Actions logs, Flatpak bundle result, GPU runner result, output, or job log are supplied.

The supplied files omit src/model.rs, src/paths.rs, src/runtime.rs, src/ui.rs, and host-tool-wrapper contents/mode, so profile mappings, verification defaults, log paths, wrapper safety, and headless behavior are unverified.
Runner availability, device ACLs, NVIDIA device nodes, and actual VAAPI/NVENC driver operation are unverified.
supported_claims: LOCAL FILE-LEVEL PROOF: .github/workflows/ci.yml invokes Flatpak-builder with a bundle, installs it, and runs the packaged command inside Flatpak.
LOCAL FILE-LEVEL PROOF: gpu.yml is workflow_dispatch-only, defines VAAPI/NVENC matrix entries, uses backend runner labels, and has a 30-minute GPU timeout.
LOCAL CODE-PATH PROOF: --hardware-fallback=false reaches runtime configuration, and engine.rs does not perform software retry when fallback is disabled.
LOCAL FILE-LEVEL PROOF: the native KDE smoke performs installation, conversion, KIO menu checks, and a Dolphin launch, but it is not a Flatpak consumer test.
prohibited_claims: Do not claim current changes are Flatpak-runtime tested until the builder consumes the current checkout.
Do not claim Flatpak Dolphin/KIO/systemd/host-tool integration works; only version/profile commands run in the package.
Do not claim production sandbox readiness while filesystem=host and broad host permissions remain.
Do not claim actual VAAPI/NVENC encoder use solely from encoder availability and HARDWARE log markers.
Do not claim the manual GPU matrix passed without successful external runner logs and verified output evidence.
required_changes: Build the current checkout with a CI-specific Flatpak manifest, pin the runtime, and add an explicit Flatpak job timeout.
Make verification markers truthful and require full output decode in the GPU smoke.
Assert exact backend encoder/device use in the application log and script.
Document and preflight systemd-run, Rust, device nodes/ACLs, drivers, and exact FFmpeg capabilities for both runners.
Protect self-hosted dispatch, pin all actions, restrict token permissions, and reduce or isolate privileged PR builds.
Remove or explicitly scope broad Flatpak host permissions and preserve auditable smoke logs/output.
residual_risks: The GPU workflow remains manual and can be waiting/unverified when no trusted runner is online.
Media metadata alone cannot prove encoder provenance; application command/selection evidence is required.
Flatpak host-wrapper behavior and packaged consumer integration remain untested by the supplied smoke.
